query: I just tried the new limited-edition matcha mochi from the bakery down the street this morning, it’s so soft and the filling isn’t too sweet at all, I ended up buying two boxes to bring to my roommates when I get home later. Also my neighbor’s cat snuck onto my balcony earlier and curled up on my potted mint plant, it was so cute I took a dozen photos of it before it ran off. Oh right, I wanted to ask if I can cancel my pending order #W8835847, I placed it by mistake.
